subject: infra.energy
name: Power supply to network sites and data centres
what_would_settle_it: An operator, utility or regulator statement quantifying outage exposure or backup provision for telecommunications sites and the planned Malabo and Bata data centres.

subject: digital.localgov
name: Municipal or district digital services
what_would_settle_it: A named municipal or provincial digital service, one-stop desk or local e-government platform, with a location and a start date.

subject: gov.policy
name: National digital strategy
what_would_settle_it: A published national digital or digital-transformation strategy for Equatorial Guinea, or an official statement that the ADIGE agenda and the Plan Nacional de Desarrollo 2035 stand in its place.

subject: data.open
name: National open data portal
what_would_settle_it: A government open-data portal or published open-data policy, or an official statement that none exists. The EITI reporting process is the only open-data commitment on the record.

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Digital literacy programme or measurement
what_would_settle_it: A named national digital-literacy programme with a participant count, or any survey measuring digital skills in Equatorial Guinea.

subject: include.divides
name: Measured gap between Bioko and the mainland
what_would_settle_it: Any figure comparing connectivity, device ownership or service use between Bioko and the mainland, or by gender, from INEGE, ORTEL or an operator.
